title: [ VX ACE ] Displaying Certain Values/Text in Yami's Skill Equip

posts.author: Phoenix136
posts.body:
Howdy! This is my first post here on the RPG Maker forums so I'm really sorry if this is in the wrong place...
I'm currently using
Yami's Skill Equip
in a project I'm working on, and would like some scripting help for displaying certain values. When selecting a skill to equip, a menu will show up displaying the skill's type, cost, speed fixture, and hit rate. I was hoping I could get help in finding a way to display extra information in this specific window.
Ideally, I'd like to be able to display addtional properties and values using the skill note window, so I could add categories for things like a skill's base power, element, or physical/magical classification and tweak the exact text displayed for each property to my liking.
While my years using VX Ace have helped me learn how to tweak certain aspects of Ruby scripts, I still have no clue how to make one myself, and would really appreciate assistance in modifying Yami's Skill Equip script to display extra properties in such a way.
Thank you!

posts.author: Phoenix136
posts.body:
Thanks for the fix!
Regarding the tech point script, my main problem is that there's no good way to have items recover it, especially in combat, and that it might be awkward in combonation with skill equip script.
The method of tech recovery in the script is based on skill ID, but it seems only a single skill can be listed for recovery in an item's notes window. I'd like the item to recover a certain amount of tech points to every skill equipped, or maybe even by the player's choice (but that's much harder to implement as it's not a feature in the original script). As far as my testing went, I wasn't able to get an item to recover more than one skill's tech points at a time.
Additionally, the system is meant to represent PP (the project I'm working on is a PMD fangame), but PP has a special property when learning/equipping new moves in the same slot. The new equipped move retains the amount of PP left of the replaced move, i.e. a move with 10/20 PP remaining would set the any new move put in that same slot a remaining PP to 10 (without overflowing its maximum). Obviously, the tech point script wasn't designed with the skill equip script in mind, and thus would allow the bypass of the game's tech point management. Adding in a feature like this seems like a much larger task than adding some text, and I'd feel bad asking for a scripter to basically rewrite much of the code, so I'm leaning more towards creating a skill cost method using the in-engine MP system.
Thank you for all of your help so far, hopefully displaying MP cost again shouldn't be too taxing.

module YES
  module SKILL_EQUIP
    ITEM_REGEX = /<display[-_ ]*text:[ ](\w*),(...*)>/i
    INPUT_SWITCH = :X # A button
    MP_PP_REGEX = /<mp[-_ ]*pp:[ ](\d+)>/i
  end
end
# ╔════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗
# ║                      End of editable region                        ║
# ╚════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝

#==============================================================================
# ¡ Window_Properties_Slot
#==============================================================================

class Window_Properties_Slot < Window_Base
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # refresh
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def refresh
    contents.clear
    return unless @actor
    if @item.nil? || @item == 0
      reset_font_settings
      change_color(normal_color, false)
      draw_icon(YES::SKILL_EQUIP::EMPTY_SKILL_ICON, 0, 0, false)
      draw_text(24, 0, contents.width, line_height, YES::SKILL_EQUIP::EMPTY_SKILL_TEXT)
    end
    return if @item.nil? || @item == 0
    reset_font_settings
    #---
    draw_item_name(@item, 0, 0)
    #---
    return if @item.nil?
    @text_data = []
    @text_data = @item.note.scan(YES::SKILL_EQUIP::ITEM_REGEX)
    draw_skill_data
  end
    
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # draw_skill_data
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def draw_skill_data
    if @item.note.scan(YES::SKILL_EQUIP::MP_PP_REGEX)[0]
      sw_data = @item.note.scan(YES::SKILL_EQUIP::MP_PP_REGEX)[0][0].to_i
    end
    i = 1
    @text_data.each { |line|
      group = line[0]; value = line[1]
      w = contents.width
      case sw_data
      when 0
        if group == "PP"
          draw_skill_cost(i*line_height)
        else
          change_color(system_color)
          draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, group)
          change_color(normal_color)
          draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, value, 2)
        end
      when 1
        change_color(system_color)
        draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, group)
        change_color(normal_color)
        draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, value, 2)
      when 2
        if @mp_pp == true && group == "PP"
          draw_skill_cost(i*line_height)
        else
          change_color(system_color)
          draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, group)
          change_color(normal_color)
          draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, value, 2)
        end
      else
        change_color(system_color)
        draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, group)
        change_color(normal_color)
        draw_text(0, i * line_height, w, line_height, value, 2)
      end
      i += 1
    }
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Frame Update
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_update_mp_pp   update
  def update
    r2_update_mp_pp
    if Input.trigger?(YES::SKILL_EQUIP::INPUT_SWITCH)
      @mp_pp = !@mp_pp 
      refresh
    end
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** RPG::UsableItem
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This is the superclass for skills and items.
#==============================================================================

class RPG::UsableItem < RPG::BaseItem
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * New method: recover_tech_points
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def recover_tech_points
    regexp = /<RECOVER TECH POINT: (\d+)>/i
    note.scan(regexp).collect { {value: $1.to_i} }
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * New method: is_tech_recover?
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def is_tech_recover?
    note =~ /<TECH RECOVER>/i ? true : false
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Game_BattlerBase
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class handles battlers. It's used as a superclass of the Game_Battler
# classes.
#==============================================================================

class Game_BattlerBase
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * New method: draw_tech_points_cost
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def skill_tech_points?(skill)
    return true if get_all_notes =~ /<INFINITE TECH POINTS>/i
    return true if self.is_a?(Game_Enemy)
    setup_tech(skill.id) if !@tech_skills[skill.id]
    @tech_skills[skill.id][:now] > 0
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: make_miss_popups
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_make_popup_block_tech_item   make_miss_popups
  def make_miss_popups(user, item)
    if item.damage.formula.include?("restore_tech_points") ||
       item.damage.formula.include?("restore_all_techs") ||
       item.is_tech_recover?
      return
    end
    r2_make_popup_block_tech_item(user, item)
  end
end

#==============================================================================
# ** Game_Actor
#------------------------------------------------------------------------------
#  This class handles actors. It's used within the Game_Actors class
# ($game_actors) and referenced by the Game_Party class ($game_party).
#==============================================================================

class Game_Actor < Game_Battler
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * New method: restore_tech_points
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def restore_tech_points(value)
    imp = false
    item = $game_party.last_item.object
    @equip_skills.each {|id| 
      next if id == 0
      sk = $data_skills[id]
      next if !sk.is_tech_skill?
      setup_tech(id) if !@tech_skills[id]
      next if tech_point(id) == tech_max(id)
      @tech_skills[id][:now] += value
      @tech_skills[id][:now] == @tech_skills[id][:max] if @tech_skills[id][:now] > @tech_skills[id][:max]
      refresh_tech(id)
      imp = true
    }
    if imp == false
      $game_party.gain_item(item, 1)
      Sound.play_buzzer
    end
  end
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * New method: restore_all_techs
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def restore_all_techs
    imp = false
    item = $game_party.last_item.object
    @skills.each {|id| 
      next if id == 0
      sk = $data_skills[id]
      next if !sk.is_tech_skill?
      setup_tech(id) if !@tech_skills[id]
      next if tech_point(id) == tech_max(id)
      @tech_skills[id][:now] = @tech_skills[id][:max]
      refresh_tech(id)
      imp = true
    }
    if imp == false
      $game_party.gain_item(item, 1)
      Sound.play_buzzer
    end
  end
end

class Scene_Item < Scene_ItemBase
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # alias method: start
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_skill_equip_start start
  def start
    r2_skill_equip_start
    create_skill_equip_window
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: create_skill_equip_window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_skill_equip_window
    wx = 0
    wy = 100
    ww = Graphics.width / 2
    wh = Graphics.height - wy
    @skill_recover = Window_SkillList_Item.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @skill_recover.z = 1000
    @skill_recover.actor = @actor
    @skill_recover.set_handler(:ok, method(:on_skill_item_ok))
    @skill_recover.set_handler(:cancel, method(:on_skill_item_cancel))
    @skill_recover.deactivate.hide
  end

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: on_skill_equip_ok
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def on_skill_item_ok
    return if @skill_recover.item == nil
    id = @skill_recover.item.id
    value = item.recover_tech_points[0][:value]
    Sound.play_buzzer if @actor.tech_point(id) == @actor.tech_max(id)
    return if @actor.tech_point(id) == @actor.tech_max(id)
    @actor.change_tech_points(id, value)
    r2_item_skill_tech_recover
    if !$game_party.has_item?(item)
      @skill_recover.deactivate.hide
      on_actor_cancel
    end
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: on_skill_equip_cancel
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def on_skill_item_cancel
    @skill_recover.deactivate.hide
    @actor_window.activate
    @skill_recover.actor(nil)
    @skill_recover.select(-1)
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Use Item
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_item_skill_tech_recover  use_item
  def use_item
    @actor = $game_party.members[@actor_window.index]
    if item.is_tech_recover? && item.recover_tech_points[0]
      $game_party.last_item.object = item
      @actor_window.deactivate
      @skill_recover.actor(@actor)
      @skill_recover.refresh
      @skill_recover.activate.show
    elsif item.damage.formula.include?("restore_tech_points") ||
        item.damage.formula.include?("restore_all_techs")
      if !actor_tech_rec(item, @actor_window.index)
        Sound.play_buzzer
        @actor_window.activate
        return
      end
      r2_item_skill_tech_recover
    else
      r2_item_skill_tech_recover
    end
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Actor [OK]
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def actor_tech_rec(item, index)
    actor = $game_party.members[index]
    can_use = false
    actor.equip_skills.each { |sk|
      can_use = true if actor.tech_point(sk) < actor.tech_max(sk)
    }
    return can_use
  end

end

class Scene_Battle < Scene_Base
  attr_accessor :item_tech_track
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Create All Windows
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_skill_battle_equip_create_windows  create_all_windows
  def create_all_windows
    r2_skill_battle_equip_create_windows
    create_skill_equip_window
    @item_tech_track = []
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: create_skill_equip_window
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def create_skill_equip_window
    wx = 0
    wy = 100
    ww = Graphics.width / 2
    wh = Graphics.height - wy
    @skill_recover = Window_BattleList_Item.new(wx, wy, ww, wh)
    @skill_recover.z = 1000
    @skill_recover.actor = @actor
    @skill_recover.set_handler(:ok, method(:on_skill_item_ok))

    @skill_recover.deactivate.hide
  end

  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: on_skill_equip_ok
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def on_skill_item_ok
    id = @skill_recover.item.id
    item = @subject.actions[0].item
    value = item.recover_tech_points[0][:value]
    Sound.play_buzzer if @actor.tech_point(id) == @actor.tech_max(id)
    return if @actor.tech_point(id) == @actor.tech_max(id)
    @actor.change_tech_points(id, value)
    @skill_recover.deactivate.hide
    r2_actor_skill_recover_item
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # new method: on_skill_equip_cancel
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def on_skill_item_cancel
    @skill_recover.deactivate.hide
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Actor [OK]
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_on_item_actor_recover_tech_ok    on_actor_ok
  def on_actor_ok
    item = @item_window.item
    skill = @skill_window.item
    last = BattleManager.actor.actions[0].item
    if item.is_a?(RPG::Item) && item.is_tech_recover? && item.recover_tech_points[0] && 
      item.recover_tech_points[0][:value] > 0 && item == last
      if !actor_tech_rec(item, @actor_window.index)
        select_actor_selection
        return
      end
      @item_tech_track.push([item, @actor_window.index])
    end
    if item.is_a?(RPG::Item) && item.is_tech_recover? && item.damage.formula.include?("restore_tech_points") && 
      item == last
      if !actor_tech_rec(item, @actor_window.index)
        select_actor_selection
        return
      end
    end
    if item.is_a?(RPG::Item) && item.is_tech_recover? && item.damage.formula.include?("restore_all_techs") && 
      item == last
      if !actor_tech_rec(item, @actor_window.index)
        select_actor_selection
        return
      end
    end
    r2_on_item_actor_recover_tech_ok
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Actor [OK]
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  def actor_tech_rec(item, index)
    actor = $game_party.members[index]
    can_use = false
    actor.equip_skills.each { |sk|
      can_use = true if actor.tech_point(sk) < actor.tech_max(sk)
    }
    return can_use
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Use Skill/Item
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_actor_skill_recover_item  use_item
  def use_item
    item = @subject.current_action.item
    i = 0; ind = 0; @actor = nil
    if item.is_tech_recover? && item.recover_tech_points[0]
      @item_tech_track.each { |lit|
        @actor = $game_party.members[lit[1]] if lit[0] == item 
        ind = i if lit[0] == item 
        i += 1
      }
      @actor_window.deactivate
      @skill_recover.actor(@actor)
      @skill_recover.subject(@subject)
      @skill_recover.refresh
      @skill_recover.activate.show
      @skill_recover.select_last
      update_for_wait while @skill_recover.active
    elsif item.damage.formula.include?("restore_tech_points") ||
        item.damage.formula.include?("restore_all_techs")
      if !actor_tech_rec(item, @actor_window.index)
        Sound.play_buzzer
        @actor_window.activate
        return
      end
      r2_actor_skill_recover_item
    else
      r2_actor_skill_recover_item
    end
  end
  
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # * Start Party Command Selection
  #--------------------------------------------------------------------------
  alias r2_party_select_reset_tech  start_party_command_selection
  def start_party_command_selection
    @item_tech_track = []
    r2_party_select_reset_tech
  end
  
end
